With OFS as your procurement partner, you can maintain operational continuity and avoid costly downtime with a proactive and well-managed spare parts supply strategy. Home Logistics & Shipping Industrial Logistics and Shipping Services An efficient logistics and shipping strategy is essential for reducing costs, streamlining operations, and supporting sustainable business growth. In today’s fast-paced global economy—driven by globalization and the expansion of emerging markets—understanding logistics as a service is more critical than ever. Outsourcing logistics management goes far beyond simply arranging transportation. It involves a comprehensive service offering that may include warehousing, order processing, inventory management, packing, assembly or final assembly, and vendor coordination. These integrated solutions create a more agile and effective supply chain. Contact Us Contact Us OFS’s Expertise At OFS, our procurement consultants bring a deep understanding of sourcing best practices combined with extensive experience in vendor management. We work closely with your team to analyze existing sourcing processes, identify areas for cost reduction, and uncover opportunities for measurable improvement. Through a strategic approach to indirect procurement, we help you streamline operations, enhance value, and drive sustainable business growth. Power Energy Transportation Biotechnology Pharmaceutical & Chemicals Heavy Engineering Electrical & Electronics Mining Minerals Oil & Gas Aviation Maintenance Services Petroleum Refining Marine Cement General Manufacturing Logistics and Procurement Procurement and logistics are the starting point of the supply chain, involving the sourcing, storage, and movement of essential materials. Logistics experts help reduce costs by optimizing transportation and procurement processes, ensuring smooth operations and greater efficiency. Logistics and Supply Chain Management Think of Supply Chain Management (SCM) as the recipe, and logistics as just one ingredient. While both focus on moving goods from origin to destination, SCM provides the overall strategy for sourcing, production, and delivery. Logistics ensures that everything arrives at the right place, at the right time—executing the plan SCM creates. Logistics and Inventory Management A key part of supply chain management, logistics and inventory management involves planning the movement and storage of goods to ensure timely, accurate delivery to customers. Larger organizations often face greater challenges, requiring precise control to maintain optimal stock levels. This prevents mismatches and ensures consistent customer satisfaction. Shipping and Logistics Management Shipping refers to the physical movement of goods, while logistics ensures that the entire process runs smoothly. Logistics encompasses everything from planning routes to coordinating deliveries—ensuring shipments are efficient, timely, and cost-effective. For example, food delivery services rely on strong logistics systems to get meals to customers fresh and on time. Transportation Management in Logistics Transportation management focuses on planning and executing the most cost-effective movement of goods. It can operate internally or through a third-party logistics provider (3PL) for outsourced fulfillment. As a key part of supply chain management, it covers all types of freight—domestic, international, inbound, and outbound. Effective transportation logistics requires strategic planning and smart procurement to ensure timely and efficient delivery. Distribution and Logistics Management Logistics focuses on planning and organizing the movement of goods, while distribution deals with their physical delivery and placement. Though distinct, both functions work together to enhance supply chain efficiency. They also align with related activities like warehousing and inventory control—ensuring products reach the right place, at the right time, and at the lowest possible cost. Why Choose OFS? OFS delivers a comprehensive approach to global logistics and supply chain optimisation. Our experts evaluate the entire process to identify cost and efficiency improvements—tailoring solutions to meet your unique operational needs. We offer customised logistics services including storage, packing, and both domestic and international shipping. With our support, clients can accelerate product delivery, respond quickly to market demands, and improve customer satisfaction. As your logistics management specialist, we simplify complexity—helping you reduce costs, scale operations, and enhance client experiences. faqs.question: What quality standards and certifications does OFS adhere to?

faqs.question: How does OFS enhance supply chain resilience against global disruptions?
faqs.answer: We employ multi-region vendor diversification across 3,000+ approved manufacturers, strategic safety buffer stock agreements, and predictive lead-time tracking to isolate operations from shipping bottlenecks.

capabilities.title: Secure Storage & Staging Yards
capabilities.description: High-capacity covered warehouses and open-yard staging for heavy industrial components, valves, drilling tools, and bulk materials.

capabilities.title: Preservation & Export Packaging
capabilities.description: Specialized rust prevention, nitrogen purging, shrink-wrapping, and certified wooden crating to protect assets in transit and long-term storage.

capabilities.title: Consolidation & Cross-Docking
capabilities.description: Consolidating shipments from multiple international suppliers into synchronized container loads for cost-efficient multimodal dispatch.

process.title: Receiving & Inward Inspection
process.desc: Verification of incoming cargo against POs, condition checking, and barcode logging.

process.title: Allocated Secure Storage
process.desc: Placement in designated racking, climate-controlled bays, or heavy-lift staging yards.

process.title: Preservation & Maintenance
process.desc: Periodic inspection, desiccant renewal, and corrosion protection for long-lead spares.

process.title: Kitting & Packing
process.desc: Custom palletizing, ISPM-15 heat-treated crating, and dangerous goods labeling.

process.title: Outbound Staging & Dispatch
process.desc: Loading, customs handover, and freight carrier integration for on-time delivery.

faqs.question: Where are OFS warehouse facilities located?
faqs.answer: OFS operates strategic staging and storage hubs situated near major international maritime ports and primary industrial corridors, facilitating rapid customs transit and multimodal dispatch.

faqs.question: Can OFS store specialized equipment requiring temperature or humidity control?
faqs.answer: Yes, our facilities include dedicated climate-controlled storage zones with humidity regulation, anti-static flooring, and 24/7 security monitoring for sensitive electronics and instrumentation.

faqs.question: Can OFS provide on-site engineering personnel for offshore assets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team consists of certified engineers with valid offshore survival (BOSIET/FOET) certifications ready for deployment to offshore rigs, platforms, and FPSOs.
